title: Share of Betelgeuse's imaged disk obscured by the dust cloud

source.name: ESO Very Large Telescope (SPHERE instrument) imaging of Betelgeuse's surface
source.publisher: Montarges et al., Nature, 2021; European Southern Observatory (ESO) press materials

notes: Direct imaging of Betelgeuse's surface showed roughly half of its southern hemisphere visibly darkened where an ejected gas plume had cooled into an obscuring dust cloud.
